# Seth (Feng) Li — sethfengli.com

> Personal homepage of Seth (Feng) Li (李枫), a full-stack and database engineer in Sydney,
> Australia: 33 years in production across fintech, digital lending, enterprise data and AI.
> Bilingual (English / 简体中文); one URL serves both, switched client-side.

## Identity

- Full-Stack Engineer and Database Developer, DASH Technology Group (WealthTech), Sydney.
- Former CTO, AME Group — founded the company's AI research centre (NLP / BERT extraction of
  financial tables from unstructured PDFs) and led an ML GIS data-mining system.
- Founder of Feng Tech (fengtech.com.au), a Sydney IT services company.
- Creator of Hui Deng Zen Temple (zen.sethfengli.com), a digital Buddhist practice site.
- Master of Engineering, Computer Application Engineering (AI & Data Mining), Xiangtan University.

## Verified work

- Triumph (DASH, 2024–present): re-architected core Holdings & Performance systems to 1/50 of the
  original compute (2,400+ vCPU×6h → 16 vCPU×4h) while carrying 4× the users and volume.
  An earlier pass delivered 4× faster on 1/22.5 of the infrastructure.
- PDF Table Extractor (AME Group, 2017–2019): reconstructs tables from unstructured PDFs using
  BERT in place of CNN+LSTM for region classification, plus graph search for border detection.
- Sniper (AME Group, 2016–2018): cash-flow and valuation reporting for thousands of projects;
  .NET logic translated to VBA/Excel so analysts could model in place.
- AME Ajax (AME Group, 2018): mining & metals finance model moved from WinForms to
  .NET Core + Angular, delivered by a 6-person team in 6 months.

## Current direction (rev 2026.10)

Four positions the site argues, each with what he is building against:

1. The agent harness is the product — tool/MCP contracts, failure semantics, cost and latency
   budgets treated as SLOs. A distributed-systems problem more than a prompt problem.
2. Context beats cleverness — hybrid retrieval, permissions carried into the vector store,
   provenance and freshness on every retrieved fact.
3. Evaluation is the new regression suite — versioned eval sets that fail the build,
   traces and feedback loops as first-class data, cost and quality measured together.
4. Regulated verticals are the open field — agent tooling is crowded; wealth, lending,
   insurance and health are not, and they demand auditable, explainable, boring systems.

Currently learning: agent frameworks on .NET (Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel
lineage), evaluation harnesses and CI gates, hybrid retrieval over enterprise SQL and documents.

## Page notes for agents

- Sections in order: hero, about, career, stack, projects, ventures, ai, insights, contact.
- The `ventures` section embeds two live third-party sites; they load only on request
  or when scrolled into view, so a fetch of this page returns no frames.
- Performance and date claims are reconciled to a single source of truth (the Projects
  section). The page carries a revision stamp (`rev 2026.10`) that moves when content does.
- Verification tooling for this repository lives in `../tools/` (not published).
